commits.subject: slice 1: SVG import into Folio proposal + nib anchors + typed loss, hostile-input budgets, SVG export, AI blocker, PDF port
plain-attribute lookups (xlink:href counted once), five focused contract tests
slice 2: gradients as typed Paint, ordered appearance rows + paint-order, stroke cap/join/miter/dash, bounded SVGZ import + gzip_svg

paint, stroke and appearance on Folio design records: import emits validated StudioDesignRecords (PAINT styles, fill_style_id node refs), export reads and Folio-validates them; crate-local Paint/Rgba/StrokeStyle/StyleProposal/AppearanceItem and VectorPath.fill_style_id removed

capabilities_done: import_svg: svg viewBox/width/height/preserveAspectRatio, g/a, path (arcs, quad, smooth -> cubic anchors, relative handles in pt), rect(rx,ry), circle, ellipse, line, polyline, polygon, transform baked, fill/stroke/stroke-width/fill-rule/fill-opacity/stroke-opacity/opacity/color/display/visibility via attributes or inline style, px->pt recorded once in Provenance

VectorProposal: Folio snapshot validated by folio::validate_document (artboard + group/vector layers, Payload::Vector SVPT ids, LayerAppearance opacity), VectorPath (nib Anchor, Winding), design (Folio StudioDesignRecords: PAINT styles + fill_style_id node refs, validated by validate_design_records), LossEntry list (Approximated, TransformBaked, Unsupported, ExternalDenied, Ignored), VectorPath::to_geometry -> nib::OwnedPath

hostile input: DOCTYPE internal subset refused (EntityDenied), external DTD id inert and reported, no href/url() ever followed (ExternalDenied), byte/node/depth/segment budgets, 1e9 coordinate cap, cancel per element and per 256 segments

export_svg (flat) and export_proposal (groups, names, visibility, opacity): deterministic text, import->export->import twice stable within 1e-9 pt, edited anchor survives; *_with_loss variants report export losses
identify_ai header sniff; import_ai always NativeEditabilityBlocked with original bytes preserved byte-exact (STU-IO-186); PdfVectorProvider trait + NoPdfProvider (PdfUnavailable)
report() Observe mapping, DESCRIPTOR, interop-vector-consumer example (--descriptor, --svg [--export], --ai)

slice 2 gradients: linearGradient/radialGradient via url(#id) with gradientUnits, gradientTransform, spreadMethod, href chain inheritance (depth 8, cycles refused, local only), stop offset/stop-color/stop-opacity (style or attribute), percent lengths, one stop = solid, no stops / degenerate bbox / singular transform = typed loss; Folio StudioPaint::{Solid,Gradient{linear|radial}} with the final gradient-space -> document-pt transform (bbox mapping folded in), stops in percent, spread, classic interpolation; gradientUnits kept as provenance (gradient_provenance)

slice 2 appearance: StudioPaintStyle.rows = ordered Fill/Stroke StudioAppearanceRows (bottom to top, blend normal, visible); SVG paint-order maps to row order; export writes [Fill,Stroke] and [Stroke,Fill] as one element, any longer stack as one path per row under a group with Approximated appearance_stack_duplicated

slice 2 stroke: width, cap (Butt/Round/Projecting wire 1..3), join (Miter/Round/Bevel wire 1..3), miter limit 1..500 (clamped and reported), dash array (odd list repeated, invalid or percent typed) and offset, StudioStrokeStyle with Length pt values (align CENTER), dash lists over Folio 256 are a typed loss, all exported

slice 2 SVGZ: import_svg detects one gzip member, inflates with miniz_oxide decompress_to_vec_with_limit under Limits.max_decompressed_bytes (default 32 MiB), verifies CRC-32 and size, never unwraps twice; gzip_svg writes deterministic SVGZ

folio migration: import_svg returns VectorProposal.design (StudioDesignRecords, document_id = snapshot) as the single source of paint/stroke/appearance, validated by folio::validate_design_records against the validated document (retained records capped at 16 per max_nodes, BudgetExceeded design_records); solid alpha = row opacity percent, gradient alpha folded into stop opacity percent (row 100), values cleaned to 1e-10 so export/import is a fixed point; export_svg(paths, design, opts) / export_proposal read the style a layer names (fill_style_id), validate each with validate_paint_style, and report hidden rows, non-normal blend, non-CENTER align, gradient midpoint/interpolation/dither, off-8-bit colours, dangling style refs as typed losses

notes.api_change_slice2: StyleProposal.fill/stroke replaced by items: Vec<AppearanceItem> (fills()/strokes() helpers); StrokePaint removed; Limits gains max_decompressed_bytes; Provenance gains decoded_len; VectorError gains Gzip(&str); the slice-1 paint-server test now uses a pattern as the unsupported server because gradients are supported; FOLIO MIGRATION (30c3e64): VectorProposal.styles/StyleProposal and crate-local Paint, Rgba, StrokeStyle, StrokeAppearance, AppearanceItem, LinearGradient, RadialGradient, GradientStop, SpreadMethod, StrokeCap, StrokeJoin removed; VectorProposal gains design (StudioDesignRecords) and gradient_provenance, plus VectorProposal::layer_style()/gradient_units(), layer_style(design, layer_id), LAYER_STYLE_REF; VectorPath.fill_style_id removed (layer to style goes through design.nodes[].style_refs.fill_style_id, one style per layer); export_svg/export_svg_with_loss take &StudioDesignRecords instead of &[StyleProposal]; Limits.max_nodes also caps design records (16 per node)
notes.folio_need: RESOLVED by Folio 0e6142c: paint, gradient, stroke and appearance rows live in StudioPaintStyle/StudioNodeDesign and this crate now uses them. Still not in Folio (typed losses here): pattern, image, CMYK, spot, gray, lab paints, gradient kinds angular/diamond/freeform/mesh, per-side stroke weights, arrowheads, gradient application mode on strokes, effect rows. Folio carries dash_offset and gradient spread without a spec field (STU-VEC-145 states no dash phase); SVG has no counterpart for gradient midpoints (STU-VEC-136), perceptual interpolation or dither, and none for per-row opacity/blend/visibility on a multi-row stack (reported on export)
notes.gradient_model: StudioGradient keeps geometry in gradient space plus one affine to document points; objectBoundingBox is converted exactly with the tight bbox of the element geometry (curve extrema), so SVG gradientUnits survives only as provenance (VectorProposal.gradient_provenance / gradient_units(style_id, row)); export always writes userSpaceOnUse with the full matrix
notes.nib_dependency: nib OwnedPath (SMB-NIB-ENG-1) landed; used via OwnedPath::from_anchors in VectorPath::to_geometry
notes.folio_note: folio StudioLayer gained text_frame (other lane); this crate sets text_frame: None
design_choices: no allow_external field on ImportPolicy: no code path fetches anything, so a switch that can only be false would mislead
element opacity lives only in Folio LayerAppearance; fill and stroke opacity are folded into paint alpha (gradient stops included)
compound SVG path = several VectorPath sharing layer_id (one Payload::Vector layer lists all ids); UNVERIFIED whether that carries compound fill-rule hole semantics
Winding::None encodes fill none (nib: no fill); the fill-rule of an unfilled path is not kept
closing curve whose end equals the first anchor is merged into the first anchor's incoming handle (Illustrator storage)
a legacy DOCTYPE with external id only is accepted and reported ExternalDenied doctype_external_id_ignored; roxmltree never resolves it
SVGZ: one gzip member only; the decompressed payload is never unwrapped again; input cap max_bytes applies to the compressed bytes

paint style names svg/<n> and publish_key svg-import/<n> are import-local ordinals (ids are synthetic and rewritten on adoption, STU-IO-190); colours are opaque 0..1 RGB with the null (document working space) profile, never an invented SCPF

one PAINT style per vector layer holds the whole stack and is named by fill_style_id (stroke-only stacks included); other style_refs keys on a vector layer are reported on export (style_ref_not_exported)
export treats Folio row opacity < 100 on a gradient as fill-opacity/stroke-opacity (SVG multiplies it with stop-opacity); import never produces it (gradient alpha is folded into the stops)
unverified: AI private-data marker names (/Illustrator, AIPrivateData, %AI) not confirmed on an Illustrator-saved fixture
whether Folio expects one SVPT per layer or several for compound paths
whether a hosting StudioDesignRecords set should adopt the import design as a merge (style ids are synthetic) or replace; this crate only proposes it
whether fill_style_id (vs stroke_style_id) is the right STU-DS-136 key for a combined fill+stroke appearance stack; Folio notes say one style per layer
